info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package flags is feature flags: ship it dark, then turn it on for who you pick.

post.summary: Evaluate runs the caller's flag definitions for one identity and returns the PostHog-shaped verdict: which flags are on (or which variant), their payloads, and whether any definition failed to compute.
post.description:
Evaluate runs the caller's flag definitions for one identity and returns the
PostHog-shaped verdict: which flags are on (or which variant), their payloads,
and whether any definition failed to compute. Evaluation is in-process over the
caller's own (org, project) definitions — no network hop, no shared KV — so a
tenant can only ever evaluate its own flags.

get.summary: ListFlagActivity returns the caller's flag change log newest-first: every create, update and delete, with the actor and the time.
get.description:
ListFlagActivity returns the caller's flag change log newest-first: every
create, update and delete, with the actor and the time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned. 1–500; anything else takes the default 100.

post.summary: Evaluate runs the caller's flag definitions for one identity and returns the PostHog-shaped verdict: which flags are on (or which variant), their payloads, and whether any definition failed to compute.
post.description:
Evaluate runs the caller's flag definitions for one identity and returns the
PostHog-shaped verdict: which flags are on (or which variant), their payloads,
and whether any definition failed to compute. Evaluation is in-process over the
caller's own (org, project) definitions — no network hop, no shared KV — so a
tenant can only ever evaluate its own flags.

get.summary: ListFlagDefinitions returns every flag definition in the caller's (org, project) store, by key, with its version and who last changed it.
get.description:
ListFlagDefinitions returns every flag definition in the caller's (org,
project) store, by key, with its version and who last changed it.

delete.summary: DeleteFlagDefinition removes one flag definition by key and records the deletion in the change log.
delete.description:
DeleteFlagDefinition removes one flag definition by key and records the
deletion in the change log. A key the caller's store does not hold is a 404.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key is the flag key to act on, from the path.

get.summary: GetFlagDefinition returns one flag definition by key, or 404 when the caller's store has none under that key.
get.description:
GetFlagDefinition returns one flag definition by key, or 404 when the caller's
store has none under that key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key is the flag key to act on, from the path.

put.summary: PutFlagDefinition creates or replaces the flag definition at the path's key and returns the stored row.
put.description:
PutFlagDefinition creates or replaces the flag definition at the path's key and
returns the stored row. The BODY IS THE DEFINITION DOCUMENT — the PostHog-shaped
JSON object the evaluator consumes — and it is stored verbatim except that its
"key" is forced to the key in the URL, so a document can never be filed under a
name other than the one it was addressed by. Every write bumps the version and
appends to the change log under the caller's identity.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key is the flag key to write, from the path.

get.summary: Health reports that the flag engine is serving.
get.description:
Health reports that the flag engine is serving. It is not gated: liveness must
be probe-able without a token.

data.description: Data is the change log newest-first: who created, updated or deleted which key, when.
Data is every definition in the caller's (org, project) store, by key.

deleted.description: Deleted is the key that no longer exists.

distinct_id.description: DistinctID is the identity the flags are evaluated for. Required.

groups.description: Groups are the group-level properties, keyed by group type index.

person_properties.description: PersonProperties are the person-level properties conditions match against.

engine.description: Engine names the evaluator this deployment runs.

ok.description: OK is true whenever the flag engine is serving.
